review_corrections: String indexed borrow cannot implicitly become a returned str; explicit slice required.
Standard/user module alias collisions reject E0011 while ordinary same-named functions remain valid.
POSIX launch-error pipes avoid fd 0/1/2 and serialize creation/CLOEXEC/fork only, not child waits.
